title: access_request
description: A device outside its access hours asks for early access (button on “Access again from …”, client_config.access.request.available). note optional (at most 80 characters, plain text). Only over the hub WebSocket (the integration relay answers home_only). The hub checks: effective rule access_requests, access hours enabled, closed by the schedule (switch_off while the switch is off, not_closed while open), one open request per device, requests_per_hour, the cooldown after a No, someone to answer. Answer: access_request_state (open) or access_request_error.
